title: Walid Regragui set to step down as Morocco coach
summary: Worn down after four years as Morocco coach, Walid Regragui is expected to step down, with the World Cup now less than four months away. The Moroccan federation, which met on Thursday, is likely to announce Regragui's successor soon. The leading candidate is Mohamed Ouahbi, who's currently in charge of the nation’s U20 world champion side.
